remainingFamilies.title: Appropriate Government and jurisdiction routing
dependencies: Approved Central-versus-State appropriate-Government decision model.
Employing-entity, establishment and location facts.
Controlled Central and State source sets for every supported route.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Complete cross-cutting legal research and create a controlled jurisdiction source pack before proposing facts or rules.

remainingFamilies.title: State Shops and Establishments
dependencies: Exact Act, rules, notifications and amendments for each supported State or Union Territory.
Establishment-type, location and operating-state facts.
State-specific legal, privacy and RAG approval.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Select the first supported State, collect and fingerprint its exact official source pack, and complete state-specific self-review.

remainingFamilies.title: Code on Wages and wage-related duties
dependencies: Current Code on Wages commencement, rules and Central/State notifications.
Approved worker-category, wage-component, rate and period model.
Transition treatment for legacy minimum-wage and bonus material.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Collect the current central framework and one bounded rate/jurisdiction pack before proposing deterministic review families.

remainingFamilies.title: Gratuity under the Code on Social Security
dependencies: Chapter V and schedule mapping with exact physical pages.
Fixed-term, continuous-service, nomination, payment and transition sources.
Approved privacy boundary for employment and nominee-related facts.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Prepare a chapter-specific controlled source mapping and self-review using the shared core only as input, not as approval.

remainingFamilies.title: Employee compensation under the Code on Social Security
dependencies: Chapter VII, schedules, rules, notifications and competent-authority sources.
Approved employment-injury, dependency, wage and period boundaries.
Privacy and specialist-review model for injury, disability, death and dispute information.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Collect and map the chapter-specific source set and design an organisational-control-only first scope.

remainingFamilies.title: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions
dependencies: Current Code commencement, Central Rules and relevant State rules.
Establishment, factory, contractor, worker, power-use and hazardous-process classifications.
Transition treatment for Factories and Contract Labour legislation.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Choose a bounded establishment/contract-workforce scope and collect exact current Central and State materials.

remainingFamilies.title: Industrial Relations and standing orders
dependencies: Current Industrial Relations Code commencement, rules and State variations.
Worker classification, threshold, union and standing-order facts.
Transition treatment for the 1946 standing-orders framework.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Collect current central transition sources and define a narrow standing-orders readiness scope.

remainingFamilies.title: Apprentices
dependencies: Current Apprentices Act, rules, designated/optional trade and portal sources.
Approved establishment, trade, quota, contract, stipend and training facts.
Boundary between apprentices and other trainees for other labour-law families.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Collect the official apprenticeship source set and complete a classification-focused self-review.

remainingFamilies.title: Child and Adolescent Labour
dependencies: Current Act, rules and hazardous-occupation/process schedule.
Privacy-safe age-band, work-type and exception facts.
Mandatory safeguarding and specialist escalation design.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Collect exact official sources and design a safeguarding-first, non-entitlement review boundary.

remainingFamilies.title: Bonded and forced labour
dependencies: Applicable constitutional, statutory, criminal and rehabilitation source boundaries.
Safe handling of coercion, debt, recruitment, movement and retaliation indicators.
Human escalation, safeguarding, access and retention controls.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Complete specialist legal and safeguarding research before collecting any potentially identifying or allegation-related fact.

remainingFamilies.title: Contract workforce cross-cutting assurance
dependencies: OSHWC/contract-labour source pack and State variations.
PF/EPF and ESI contractor-control approvals.
Approved principal-employer, contractor, site, licence and welfare fact model.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Complete the underlying OSHWC source pack and treat PF/EPF and ESI contractor controls as separate dependencies, not substitutes.

remainingFamilies.title: Multi-country employment
dependencies: Selected country and employing-entity scope.
Immigration, tax, payroll, social-security and employment-law source packs.
Cross-border data-transfer and provider-processing approval.
remainingFamilies.nextControlledAction: Select a country pair and obtain specialist jurisdictional approval before creating any product rule or source pack.

globalRules: No family in remainingFamilies may have an active rule, assessment capture, RAG catalogue, endpoint, UI result or runtime activation.
Knowledge-base records and legacy product claims are not controlled legal source packs.
Shared source availability does not approve a chapter-specific interpretation.
A source pack, self-review, fact contract and legal-review packet must be completed before a repository onboarding batch is proposed.
Blank, informal, incomplete or internal review is not approval.
State, historical, exemption, enforcement, individual-entitlement and cross-border questions remain specialist-review paths unless separately approved.
